title: Data processing method and system based on neural network and federal learning
assignee: Zhongan Information Technology Service Co Ltd

pse.problem: Incomplete data features in vertical federated learning and transfer federated learning
pse.solution_function: Develops a method for joint modeling by using encryption and decryption neural networks trained on randomly generated data. Each client uses local data to train an encrypted neural network, then exchanges loss values to achieve joint modeling.
pse.solution_structure: Encryption and decryption neural network consisting of M encryption neural networks and a decryption neural network (M is the number of clients).
pse.solution_implementation: Train the encrypted neural networks on randomly generated data until convergence, then send them to each client. Each client trains their encrypted neural network with local data and exchanges loss values for joint modeling.
pse.effect: Improves efficiency and reduces complexity compared to previous methods of feature complementation
